dialogues.jp: 「月城、まだいたんだ……」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro, you're still here..."
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro, you're still here..."

dialogues.jp: こくんと頷く月城。
dialogues.en: She nodded.
dialogues.text: She nodded.

dialogues.jp:
日も陰ろうとしているのに、月城は草の前でしゃ
がんでいた。
dialogues.en:
Squatting in front of the plant, as if protecting it from
the sun, was Tsukishiro.
dialogues.text:
Squatting in front of the plant, as if protecting it from
the sun, was Tsukishiro.

dialogues.jp:
制服姿のままってことは、お昼に学校が終わっ
てから、ずっとここにいたのだろう。
dialogues.en:
Her uniformed self indicated that she's been here since
school ended.
dialogues.text:
Her uniformed self indicated that she's been here since
school ended.

dialogues.jp: 「寒くないか？」
dialogues.en: "Aren't you cold?"
dialogues.text: "Aren't you cold?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……慣れてるから」
dialogues.en: "...I'm used to it."
dialogues.text: "...I'm used to it."

dialogues.jp: いつものようにぼそりと答える月城。
dialogues.en: Her reply was barely audible, a whisper if that.
dialogues.text: Her reply was barely audible, a whisper if that.

dialogues.jp: 「帰らないのか？」
dialogues.en: "What about going back home?"
dialogues.text: "What about going back home?"

dialogues.jp:
この場所はもうすっかり日陰になっており、ひ
とかけらの日なたもなかった。
dialogues.en:
It must be uncomfortable for her to expose herself to the
sun for so long like that...
dialogues.text:
It must be uncomfortable for her to expose herself to the
sun for so long like that...

dialogues.jp: ふるふると首を横に振る月城。
dialogues.en: But she simply shook her head no.
dialogues.text: But she simply shook her head no.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……もう少し」
dialogues.en: "...Just a little longer."
dialogues.text: "...Just a little longer."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「そうか。俺も近くに来たから、ちょっと寄っ
　ただけなんだけど、なんなら、一緒に帰るか」
dialogues.en:
"I see. I live close by, so I just came to check on it.
Shall we head back together?"
dialogues.text:
"I see. I live close by, so I just came to check on it.
Shall we head back together?"

dialogues.jp: 月城は、またふるふると首を振った。
dialogues.en: Once again, Tsukishiro shook her head.
dialogues.text: Once again, Tsukishiro shook her head.

dialogues.jp: すっと立ち上がった月城は、俺の方を向き、
dialogues.en: She then suddenly stood up, and faced me for a split-second;
dialogues.text: She then suddenly stood up, and faced me for a split-second;

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……先輩、サヨナラ」
dialogues.en: "...Senpai, farewell."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai, farewell."

dialogues.jp:
とだけ言うと、人形と鞄を大事そうに抱え、す
たすたと走り、桜公園の方へ消えてしまった。
dialogues.en:
Upon saying so, she hugged her doll and bag tightly, and
dashed off in the direction of the Sakura Park, disappearing
into it.
dialogues.text:
Upon saying so, she hugged her doll and bag tightly, and
dashed off in the direction of the Sakura Park, disappearing
into it.

dialogues.jp: 軽く走っているだけなのに、やたらと足が速い。
dialogues.en:
She didn't seem to be putting much effort into it, yet her
footwork was amazingly quick.
dialogues.text:
She didn't seem to be putting much effort into it, yet her
footwork was amazingly quick.

dialogues.jp:
まるで、俺だけ、時間の流れから少し外されて
しまったかのように。
dialogues.en:
As if she wanted to spend as little time with me as
possible.
dialogues.text:
As if she wanted to spend as little time with me as
possible.

dialogues.jp: 「仕方ない、俺も帰るか……」
dialogues.en: "Whatever, I'd head home too..."
dialogues.text: "Whatever, I'd head home too..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ふぅとため息をつき、月城の消えていっ
た公園の方へ歩いていった
dialogues.en: With a heavy sigh, I followed Tsukishiro's path.
dialogues.text: With a heavy sigh, I followed Tsukishiro's path.

dialogues.jp:
いつもと変わらぬ速度。俺の身体は、時間の流
れにきちんと戻されたようだ。
dialogues.en: At my usual walking speed. I was in no hurry, unlike her.
dialogues.text: At my usual walking speed. I was in no hurry, unlike her.

dialogues.jp: ◆どっちなんだろう◆
dialogues.en: ◆Which one is it?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Which one is it?◆

dialogues.jp:
体育館の裏に行くと、放課後だというのに、あ
いかわらず、月城はそこにいた。
dialogues.en:
Heading to the rear of the gym after school, as usual,
Tsukishiro was there.
dialogues.text:
Heading to the rear of the gym after school, as usual,
Tsukishiro was there.

dialogues.jp:
一緒に帰らないか、と誘うと『サヨナラ』と言
われて、俺は置いて行かれてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I asked whether we could go home together, but all she said
was "Farewell", then disappeared from my sight.
dialogues.text:
I asked whether we could go home together, but all she said
was "Farewell", then disappeared from my sight.

dialogues.jp:
仲良くなれてきたのか、嫌われているのか、よ
くわからないな、まったく……。
dialogues.en:
I really don't know whether she wants to get closer or not,
sheesh...
dialogues.text:
I really don't know whether she wants to get closer or not,
sheesh...
